issues.description: The template declares number_of_qubits_query_register as a float (0.0) which is incompatible with QuantumRegister (expects an integer). The problem statement and solution both expect a 2-qubit query register for Exercise 1. This type mismatch in the template will cause errors when students instantiate QuantumRegister and prevents them from running or building the intended circuit.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template declaration to an integer matching the exercise: set number_of_qubits_query_register = 2 (int) so QuantumRegister is constructed with an integer number of qubits, consistent with the problem statement and solution.
